sql_text: SELECT catalog_page.cp_type, web_returns.wr_order_number, catalog_returns.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk FROM catalog_page FULL JOIN catalog_returns ON catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_sk = catalog_returns.cr_catalog_page_sk FULL JOIN web_returns ON catalog_returns.cr_refunded_addr_sk = web_returns.wr_refunded_addr_sk LIMIT 416

SELECT catalog_page.cp_start_date_sk, promotion.p_channel_details, web_returns.wr_reversed_charge, COUNT(*) FROM promotion LEFT ANTI JOIN web_returns ON promotion.p_item_sk = web_returns.wr_item_sk LEFT JOIN catalog_page ON catalog_page.cp_start_date_sk = promotion.p_start_date_sk GROUP BY catalog_page.cp_start_date_sk, promotion.p_channel_details, web_returns.wr_reversed_charge LIMIT 113

SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS itemrevenue, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) * 100.0000 / SUM(SUM(ws_ext_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_class) AS revenueratio FROM web_sales, item, date_dim WHERE ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Sports', 'Books', 'Home') AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-02-22' AS DATE) AND CAST('1999-03-24' AS DATE) GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price ORDER BY i_category NULLS LAST, i_class NULLS LAST, i_item_id NULLS LAST, i_item_desc NULLS LAST, revenueratio NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

WITH customer_total_return AS (SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return FROM web_returns, date_dim, customer_address WHERE wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2002 AND wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state) SELECT c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1, customer_address, customer WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2 WHERE ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state) AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'GA' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return LIMIT 100

WITH ssr AS (SELECT s_store_id AS store_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns_, SUM(ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit FROM store_sales LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns ON (ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number), date_dim, store, item, promotion WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-22' AS DATE) AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_current_price > 50 AND ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND p_channel_tv = 'N' GROUP BY s_store_id), csr AS (SELECT cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0)) AS returns_, SUM(cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit FROM catalog_sales LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number), date_dim, catalog_page, item, promotion WHERE cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-22' AS DATE) AND cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_current_price > 50 AND cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND p_channel_tv = 'N' GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id), wsr AS (SELECT web_site_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns_, SUM(ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit FROM web_sales LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns ON (ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number), date_dim, web_site, item, promotion WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-22' AS DATE) AND ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_current_price > 50 AND ws_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND p_channel_tv = 'N' GROUP BY web_site_id) SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns_) AS returns_, SUM(profit) AS profit FROM (SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, CONCAT('store', COALESCE(store_id, '')) AS id, sales, returns_, profit FROM ssr UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, CONCAT('catalog_page', COALESCE(catalog_page_id, '')) AS id, sales, returns_, profit FROM csr UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, CONCAT('web_site', COALESCE(web_site_id, '')) AS id, sales, returns_, profit FROM wsr) AS x GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id) ORDER BY channel, id LIMIT 100

SELECT warehouse.w_country, catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_id, catalog_returns.cr_warehouse_sk FROM warehouse LEFT ANTI JOIN catalog_returns ON catalog_returns.cr_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN catalog_page ON catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_sk = catalog_returns.cr_catalog_page_sk LIMIT 294

SELECT catalog_sales.cs_coupon_amt, promotion.p_promo_name, call_center.cc_rec_end_date, COUNT(*) FROM call_center INNER JOIN catalog_sales ON call_center.cc_call_center_sk = catalog_sales.cs_call_center_sk LEFT JOIN promotion ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = promotion.p_item_sk GROUP BY catalog_sales.cs_coupon_amt, promotion.p_promo_name, call_center.cc_rec_end_date LIMIT 477

SELECT store_sales.ss_store_sk, customer.c_email_address, catalog_sales.cs_ext_sales_price, COUNT(*) FROM store_sales FULL JOIN customer ON customer.c_customer_sk = store_sales.ss_customer_sk INNER JOIN catalog_sales ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_time_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk GROUP BY store_sales.ss_store_sk, customer.c_email_address, catalog_sales.cs_ext_sales_price LIMIT 305

SELECT catalog_sales.cs_wholesale_cost, web_sales.ws_item_sk, catalog_returns.cr_ship_mode_sk, COUNT(*) FROM catalog_returns LEFT JOIN web_sales ON catalog_returns.cr_item_sk = web_sales.ws_item_sk LEFT JOIN catalog_sales ON catalog_returns.cr_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk GROUP BY catalog_sales.cs_wholesale_cost, web_sales.ws_item_sk, catalog_returns.cr_ship_mode_sk LIMIT 282
SELECT time_dim.t_time, COUNT(*) FROM time_dim GROUP BY time_dim.t_time LIMIT 438

SELECT store_returns.sr_return_ship_cost, web_returns.wr_order_number, catalog_returns.cr_reason_sk, COUNT(*) FROM web_returns LEFT ANTI JOIN catalog_returns ON catalog_returns.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = web_returns.wr_returning_hdemo_sk LEFT ANTI JOIN store_returns ON catalog_returns.cr_returned_date_sk = store_returns.sr_returned_date_sk GROUP BY store_returns.sr_return_ship_cost, web_returns.wr_order_number, catalog_returns.cr_reason_sk LIMIT 202

SELECT web_returns.wr_return_tax, customer.c_customer_id, store_returns.sr_return_amt_inc_tax, COUNT(*) FROM customer LEFT ANTI JOIN store_returns ON customer.c_customer_sk = store_returns.sr_customer_sk LEFT ANTI JOIN web_returns ON store_returns.sr_reason_sk = web_returns.wr_reason_sk GROUP BY web_returns.wr_return_tax, customer.c_customer_id, store_returns.sr_return_amt_inc_tax LIMIT 288

SELECT customer.c_birth_country, store_returns.sr_net_loss, web_page.wp_image_count, COUNT(*) FROM customer INNER JOIN web_page ON customer.c_customer_sk = web_page.wp_customer_sk FULL JOIN store_returns ON store_returns.sr_customer_sk = web_page.wp_customer_sk GROUP BY customer.c_birth_country, store_returns.sr_net_loss, web_page.wp_image_count LIMIT 422

SELECT SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_sum, i_category, i_class, GROUPING(i_category) + GROUPING(i_class) AS lochierarchy, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY GROUPING(i_category) + GROUPING(i_class), CASE WHEN GROUPING(i_class) = 0.0 THEN i_category END ORDER BY SUM(ws_net_paid) DESC) AS rank_within_parent FROM web_sales, date_dim AS d1, item WHERE d1.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1256.47 AND 1137.68 + 12.65 AND d1.d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk AND i_item_sk = ws_item_sk GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_category, i_class) ORDER BY lochierarchy DESC NULLS FIRST, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i_category) + GROUPING(i_class) = 0.0 THEN i_category END NULLS LAST, rank_within_parent NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

WITH customer_total_return AS (SELECT cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return FROM catalog_returns, date_dim, customer_address WHERE cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2325.76 AND cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state) SELECT c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type, ctr_total_return FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1, customer_address, customer WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.13 FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2 WHERE ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state) AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'GA' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id NULLS LAST, c_salutation NULLS LAST, c_first_name NULLS LAST, c_last_name NULLS LAST, ca_street_number NULLS LAST, ca_street_name NULLS LAST, ca_street_type NULLS LAST, ca_suite_number NULLS LAST, ca_city NULLS LAST, ca_county NULLS LAST, ca_state NULLS LAST, ca_zip NULLS LAST, ca_country NULLS LAST, ca_gmt_offset NULLS LAST, ca_location_type NULLS LAST, ctr_total_return NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT catalog_sales.cs_list_price, store_returns.sr_reversed_charge, catalog_returns.cr_catalog_page_sk FROM store_returns LEFT ANTI JOIN catalog_returns ON catalog_returns.cr_item_sk = store_returns.sr_item_sk INNER JOIN catalog_sales ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = store_returns.sr_item_sk LIMIT 251

SELECT store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk, customer.c_preferred_cust_flag, web_page.wp_customer_sk FROM customer FULL JOIN web_page ON customer.c_customer_sk = web_page.wp_customer_sk LEFT JOIN store_sales ON customer.c_customer_sk = store_sales.ss_customer_sk LIMIT 279

WITH ss AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Music') AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1987.95 AND d_moy = 10.21 AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.16 GROUP BY i_item_id), cs AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Music') AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1935.37 AND d_moy = 8.7 AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.31 GROUP BY i_item_id), ws AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Music') AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1786.16 AND d_moy = 8.32 AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.25 GROUP BY i_item_id) SELECT i_item_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM ss UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws) AS tmp1 GROUP BY i_item_id ORDER BY i_item_id NULLS LAST, total_sales NULLS LAST LIMIT 100
SELECT time_dim.t_hour FROM time_dim LIMIT 131

SELECT store_sales.ss_ticket_number, catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk, web_page.wp_image_count, COUNT(*) FROM web_page INNER JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = web_page.wp_customer_sk FULL JOIN catalog_sales ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_time_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk GROUP BY store_sales.ss_ticket_number, catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk, web_page.wp_image_count LIMIT 55

SELECT item.i_formulation, store_returns.sr_return_quantity, web_returns.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk, COUNT(*) FROM item FULL JOIN web_returns ON item.i_item_sk = web_returns.wr_item_sk LEFT ANTI JOIN store_returns ON store_returns.sr_returned_date_sk = web_returns.wr_returned_date_sk GROUP BY item.i_formulation, store_returns.sr_return_quantity, web_returns.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk LIMIT 386

WITH results AS (SELECT SUM(ss_net_profit) AS ss_net_profit, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_ext_sales_price, (SUM(ss_net_profit) * 0.96) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price), 0) AS gross_margin, i_category, i_class, 0.0 AS g_category, 0.0 AS g_class FROM store_sales, date_dim AS d1, item, store WHERE d1.d_year = 2296.42 AND d1.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk AND s_state = 'TN' GROUP BY i_category, i_class), results_rollup AS (SELECT gross_margin, i_category, i_class, 0.0 AS t_category, 0.0 AS t_class, 0.0 AS lochierarchy FROM results UNION SELECT (SUM(ss_net_profit) * 0.89) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price), 0) AS gross_margin, i_category, NULL AS i_class, 0.0 AS t_category, 1.07 AS t_class, 0.88 AS lochierarchy FROM results GROUP BY i_category UNION SELECT (SUM(ss_net_profit) * 0.85) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price), 0) AS gross_margin, NULL AS i_category, NULL AS i_class, 0.87 AS t_category, 0.87 AS t_class, 1.66 AS lochierarchy FROM results) SELECT gross_margin, i_category, i_class, lochierarchy, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lochierarchy, CASE WHEN t_class = 0.0 THEN i_category END ORDER BY gross_margin ASC NULLS LAST) AS rank_within_parent FROM results_rollup ORDER BY lochierarchy DESC NULLS FIRST, CASE WHEN lochierarchy = 0.0 THEN i_category END NULLS LAST, rank_within_parent NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

WITH ssr AS (SELECT s_store_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns_, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM (SELECT ss_store_sk AS store_sk, ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, ss_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, ss_net_profit AS profit, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(8.23, 2.19)) AS return_amt, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(6.54, 1.75)) AS net_loss FROM store_sales UNION ALL SELECT sr_store_sk AS store_sk, sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(7.15, 2.38)) AS sales_price, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(5.94, 2.18)) AS profit, sr_return_amt AS return_amt, sr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM store_returns) AS salesreturns, date_dim, store WHERE date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-06' AS DATE) AND store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY s_store_id), csr AS (SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns_, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM (SELECT cs_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk, cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, cs_net_profit AS profit, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(7.0, 2.21)) AS return_amt, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(6.14, 2.11)) AS net_loss FROM catalog_sales UNION ALL SELECT cr_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk, cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(6.14, 1.9)) AS sales_price, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(8.07, 1.98)) AS profit, cr_return_amount AS return_amt, cr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM catalog_returns) AS salesreturns, date_dim, catalog_page WHERE date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-06' AS DATE) AND page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id), wsr AS (SELECT web_site_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns_, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM (SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk, ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, ws_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, ws_net_profit AS profit, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(7.71, 1.88)) AS return_amt, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(6.94, 1.67)) AS net_loss FROM web_sales UNION ALL SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk, wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(7.4, 1.62)) AS sales_price, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(5.91, 2.02)) AS profit, wr_return_amt AS return_amt, wr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM web_returns LEFT OUTER JOIN web_sales ON (wr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND wr_order_number = ws_order_number)) AS salesreturns, date_dim, web_site WHERE date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-06' AS DATE) AND wsr_web_site_sk = web_site_sk GROUP BY web_site_id) SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns_) AS returns_, SUM(profit) AS profit FROM (SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, CONCAT('store', COALESCE(COALESCE(s_store_id, ''), '')) AS id, sales, returns_, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM ssr UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, CONCAT('catalog_page', COALESCE(COALESCE(cp_catalog_page_id, ''), '')) AS id, sales, returns_, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM csr UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, CONCAT('web_site', COALESCE(COALESCE(web_site_id, ''), '')) AS id, sales, returns_, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM wsr) AS x GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id) ORDER BY channel NULLS LAST, id NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk, call_center.cc_rec_end_date, store.s_store_id, COUNT(*) FROM store FULL JOIN call_center ON call_center.cc_closed_date_sk = store.s_closed_date_sk FULL JOIN store_sales ON store.s_store_sk = store_sales.ss_store_sk GROUP BY store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk, call_center.cc_rec_end_date, store.s_store_id LIMIT 270

SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS itemrevenue, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) * 116.45 / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(cs_ext_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_class), 0) AS revenueratio FROM catalog_sales, item, date_dim WHERE cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Sports', 'Books', 'Home') AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-02-22' AS DATE) AND CAST('1999-03-24' AS DATE) GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price ORDER BY i_category NULLS LAST, i_class NULLS LAST, i_item_id NULLS LAST, i_item_desc NULLS LAST, revenueratio NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT cc_call_center_id AS Call_Center, cc_name AS Call_Center_Name, cc_manager AS Manager, SUM(cr_net_loss) AS Returns_Loss FROM call_center, date_dim, customer, customer_address, customer_demographics WHERE cr_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk AND cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cr_returning_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND cd_demo_sk = c_current_cdemo_sk AND hd_demo_sk = c_current_hdemo_sk AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND d_year = 1636.29 AND d_moy = 10.43 AND ((cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd_education_status = 'Unknown') OR (cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')) AND hd_buy_potential LIKE 'Unknown%' AND ca_gmt_offset = -6.48 GROUP BY cc_call_center_id, cc_name, cc_manager, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status ORDER BY SUM(cr_net_loss) DESC

SELECT store_sales.ss_coupon_amt, item.i_item_id, web_sales.ws_warehouse_sk, COUNT(*) FROM store_sales LEFT JOIN item ON item.i_item_sk = store_sales.ss_item_sk LEFT JOIN web_sales ON store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk = web_sales.ws_sold_time_sk GROUP BY store_sales.ss_coupon_amt, item.i_item_id, web_sales.ws_warehouse_sk LIMIT 381

SELECT ca_zip, ca_city, SUM(ws_sales_price) FROM web_sales, customer, customer_address, item WHERE ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND (SUBSTRING(ca_zip, 1, 5) IN ('85669', '86197', '88274', '83405', '86475', '85392', '85460', '80348', '81792') OR i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_item_sk IN (2.0, 3.52, 5.3, 7.64, 11.15, 11.44, 19.85, 20.58, 21.19, 26.38))) AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_qoy = 2.34 AND d_year = 1994.36 GROUP BY ca_zip, ca_city ORDER BY ca_zip NULLS LAST, ca_city NULLS LAST LIMIT 100
SELECT customer_address.ca_location_type, COUNT(*) FROM customer_address GROUP BY customer_address.ca_location_type LIMIT 263

SELECT web_site.web_site_id, call_center.cc_suite_number, catalog_returns.cr_returning_customer_sk, COUNT(*) FROM web_site FULL JOIN call_center ON call_center.cc_open_date_sk = web_site.ws_open_date_sk LEFT ANTI JOIN catalog_returns ON call_center.cc_call_center_sk = catalog_returns.cr_call_center_sk GROUP BY web_site.web_site_id, call_center.cc_suite_number, catalog_returns.cr_returning_customer_sk LIMIT 254

SELECT s_store_name, s_store_id, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Sunday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sun_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Monday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS mon_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Tuesday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS tue_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Wednesday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS wed_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Thursday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS thu_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Friday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS fri_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Saturday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sat_sales FROM date_dim, store_sales, store WHERE d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk AND s_gmt_offset = -6.0 AND d_year = 2026.67 GROUP BY s_store_name, s_store_id ORDER BY s_store_name NULLS LAST, s_store_id NULLS LAST, sun_sales NULLS LAST, mon_sales NULLS LAST, tue_sales NULLS LAST, wed_sales NULLS LAST, thu_sales NULLS LAST, fri_sales NULLS LAST, sat_sales NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

WITH my_customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk FROM (SELECT cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cs_item_sk AS item_sk FROM catalog_sales UNION ALL SELECT ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws_item_sk AS item_sk FROM web_sales) AS cs_or_ws_sales, item, date_dim, customer WHERE sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category = 'Women' AND i_class = 'maternity' AND c_customer_sk = cs_or_ws_sales.customer_sk AND d_moy = 11.13 AND d_year = 1785.27), my_revenue AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue FROM my_customers, store_sales, customer_address, store, date_dim WHERE c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_county = s_county AND ca_state = s_state AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN (SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq + 0.99 FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2324.33 AND d_moy = 10.8) AND (SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq + 3.2 FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2009.79 AND d_moy = 13.34) GROUP BY c_customer_sk), segments AS (SELECT CAST(ROUND(revenue / NULLIF(59.34, 0)) AS INT) AS SEGMENT FROM my_revenue) SELECT SEGMENT, COUNT(*) AS num_customers, SEGMENT * 57.34 AS segment_base FROM segments GROUP BY SEGMENT ORDER BY SEGMENT NULLS LAST, num_customers NULLS LAST, segment_base NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

WITH web_v1 AS (SELECT ws_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date, SUM(SUM(ws_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY ws_item_sk ORDER BY d_date NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS cume_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 962.59 AND 1134.72 + 9.31 AND NOT ws_item_sk IS NULL GROUP BY ws_item_sk, d_date), store_v1 AS (SELECT ss_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date, SUM(SUM(ss_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_item_sk ORDER BY d_date NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS cume_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 974.72 AND 1403.07 + 10.77 AND NOT ss_item_sk IS NULL GROUP BY ss_item_sk, d_date) SELECT * FROM (SELECT item_sk, d_date, web_sales, store_sales, MAX(web_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS web_cumulative, MAX(store_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS store_cumulative FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN NOT web.item_sk IS NULL THEN web.item_sk ELSE store.item_sk END AS item_sk, CASE WHEN NOT web.d_date IS NULL THEN web.d_date ELSE store.d_date END AS d_date, web.cume_sales AS web_sales, store.cume_sales AS store_sales FROM web_v1 AS web FULL OUTER JOIN store_v1 AS store ON (web.item_sk = store.item_sk AND web.d_date = store.d_date)) AS x) AS y WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative ORDER BY item_sk NULLS LAST, d_date NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_current_price FROM item, inventory, date_dim, catalog_sales WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 55.97 AND 63.54 + 30.46 AND inv_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date_sk = inv_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-02-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-04-01' AS DATE) AND i_manufact_id IN (688.59, 1029.48, 592.67, 856.09) AND inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 83.9 AND 463.96 AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_current_price ORDER BY i_item_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

WITH inv AS (SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, stdev, mean, CASE mean WHEN 0.0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev / NULLIF(mean, 0) END AS cov FROM (SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) * 0.87 AS stdev, AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean FROM inventory, item, warehouse, date_dim WHERE inv_item_sk = i_item_sk AND inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND inv_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2307.45 GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy) AS foo WHERE CASE mean WHEN 0.0 THEN 0.0 ELSE stdev / NULLIF(mean, 0) END > 0.93) SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk AS wsk1, inv1.i_item_sk AS isk1, inv1.d_moy AS dmoy1, inv1.mean AS mean1, inv1.cov AS cov1, inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov FROM inv AS inv1, inv AS inv2 WHERE inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk AND inv1.d_moy = 0.86 AND inv2.d_moy = 0.95 + 0.81 ORDER BY inv1.w_warehouse_sk NULLS LAST, inv1.i_item_sk NULLS LAST, inv1.d_moy NULLS LAST, inv1.mean NULLS LAST, inv1.cov NULLS LAST, inv2.d_moy NULLS LAST, inv2.mean NULLS LAST, inv2.cov NULLS LAST

WITH customer_total_return AS (SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk, ca_state AS ctr_state, SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return FROM web_returns, date_dim, customer_address WHERE wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2254.42 AND wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state) SELECT c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1, customer_address, customer WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.38 FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2 WHERE ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state) AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'GA' AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk ORDER BY c_customer_id NULLS LAST, c_salutation NULLS LAST, c_first_name NULLS LAST, c_last_name NULLS LAST, c_preferred_cust_flag NULLS LAST, c_birth_day NULLS LAST, c_birth_month NULLS LAST, c_birth_year NULLS LAST, c_birth_country NULLS LAST, c_login NULLS LAST, c_email_address NULLS LAST, c_last_review_date_sk NULLS LAST, ctr_total_return NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

currency_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_ratio NULLS LAST) AS return_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_ratio NULLS LAST) AS currency_rank FROM (SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(16.31, 4.53)) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(17.22, 3.53)), 0)) AS return_ratio, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(16.75, 4.43)) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_net_paid, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(12.7, 3.85)), 0)) AS currency_ratio FROM web_sales AS ws LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns AS wr ON (ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk), date_dim WHERE wr.wr_return_amt > 9164.76 AND ws.ws_net_profit > 1.1 AND ws.ws_net_paid > 0.0 AND ws.ws_quantity > 0.0 AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2071.03 AND d_moy = 12.94 GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk) AS in_web) AS web WHERE (web.return_rank <= 9.2 OR web.currency_rank <= 8.1) UNION SELECT 'catalog' AS channel, catalog.item, catalog.return_ratio, catalog.return_rank, catalog.currency_rank FROM (SELECT item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_ratio NULLS LAST) AS return_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_ratio NULLS LAST) AS currency_rank FROM (SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(17.1, 4.2)) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(16.98, 3.95)), 0)) AS return_ratio, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(12.08, 3.68)) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_net_paid, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(16.85, 4.34)), 0)) AS currency_ratio FROM catalog_sales AS cs LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns AS cr ON (cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk), date_dim WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 8649.51 AND cs.cs_net_profit > 0.98 AND cs.cs_net_paid > 0.0 AND cs.cs_quantity > 0.0 AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2096.22 AND d_moy = 14.02 GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk) AS in_cat) AS CATALOG WHERE (catalog.return_rank <= 11.31 OR catalog.currency_rank <= 10.88) UNION SELECT 'store' AS channel, store.item, store.return_ratio, store.return_rank, store.currency_rank FROM (SELECT item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_ratio NULLS LAST) AS return_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_ratio NULLS LAST) AS currency_rank FROM (SELECT sts.ss_item_sk AS item, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(15.54, 3.57)) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sts.ss_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(16.77, 3.87)), 0)) AS return_ratio, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(16.36, 4.16)) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sts.ss_net_paid, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(15.3, 3.98)), 0)) AS currency_ratio FROM store_sales AS sts LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns AS sr ON (sts.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND sts.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk), date_dim WHERE sr.sr_return_amt > 11631.65 AND sts.ss_net_profit > 1.17 AND sts.ss_net_paid > 0.0 AND sts.ss_quantity > 0.0 AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1716.89 AND d_moy = 11.58 GROUP BY sts.ss_item_sk) AS in_store) AS store WHERE (store.return_rank <= 8.81 OR store.currency_rank <= 8.97)) AS sq1 ORDER BY 1.17 NULLS LAST, 3.4 NULLS LAST, 5.23 NULLS LAST, 1.77 NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

WITH results AS (SELECT SUM(ss_net_profit) AS ss_net_profit, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_ext_sales_price, (SUM(ss_net_profit) * 1.0000) / SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS gross_margin, i_category, i_class, 0 AS g_category, 0 AS g_class FROM store_sales, date_dim AS d1, item, store WHERE d1.d_year = 2001 AND d1.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk AND s_state = 'TN' GROUP BY i_category, i_class), results_rollup AS (SELECT gross_margin, i_category, i_class, 0 AS t_category, 0 AS t_class, 0 AS lochierarchy FROM results UNION SELECT (SUM(ss_net_profit) * 1.0000) / SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS gross_margin, i_category, NULL AS i_class, 0 AS t_category, 1 AS t_class, 1 AS lochierarchy FROM results GROUP BY i_category UNION SELECT (SUM(ss_net_profit) * 1.0000) / SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS gross_margin, NULL AS i_category, NULL AS i_class, 1 AS t_category, 1 AS t_class, 2 AS lochierarchy FROM results) SELECT gross_margin, i_category, i_class, lochierarchy, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lochierarchy, CASE WHEN t_class = 0 THEN i_category END ORDER BY gross_margin ASC NULLS LAST) AS rank_within_parent FROM results_rollup ORDER BY lochierarchy DESC NULLS FIRST, CASE WHEN lochierarchy = 0 THEN i_category END, rank_within_parent LIMIT 100

WITH cross_items AS (SELECT i_item_sk AS ss_item_sk FROM item, (SELECT iss.i_brand_id AS brand_id, iss.i_class_id AS class_id, iss.i_category_id AS category_id FROM store_sales, item AS iss, date_dim AS d1 WHERE ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND d1.d_year BETWEEN 1951.97 AND 2266.98 + 2.12 INTERSECT SELECT ics.i_brand_id, ics.i_class_id, ics.i_category_id FROM catalog_sales, item AS ics, date_dim AS d2 WHERE cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_year BETWEEN 2243.91 AND 1798.96 + 2.1 INTERSECT SELECT iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id FROM web_sales, item AS iws, date_dim AS d3 WHERE ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk AND d3.d_year BETWEEN 1970.47 AND 1744.45 + 1.95) AS sq1 WHERE i_brand_id = brand_id AND i_class_id = class_id AND i_category_id = category_id), avg_sales AS (SELECT AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales FROM (SELECT ss_quantity AS quantity, ss_list_price AS list_price FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year BETWEEN 2322.58 AND 1962.5 + 2.18 UNION ALL SELECT cs_quantity AS quantity, cs_list_price AS list_price FROM catalog_sales, date_dim WHERE cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year BETWEEN 2206.43 AND 2362.07 + 2.0 UNION ALL SELECT ws_quantity AS quantity, ws_list_price AS list_price FROM web_sales, date_dim WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year BETWEEN 1994.1 AND 1728.17 + 2.24) AS sq2) SELECT channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, SUM(sales) AS sum_sales, SUM(number_sales) AS sum_number_sales FROM (SELECT 'store' AS channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sales, COUNT(*) AS number_sales FROM store_sales, item, date_dim WHERE ss_item_sk IN (SELECT ss_item_sk FROM cross_items) AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1643.01 + 2.33 AND d_moy = 10.8 GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales) UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog' AS channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sales, COUNT(*) AS number_sales FROM catalog_sales, item, date_dim WHERE cs_item_sk IN (SELECT ss_item_sk FROM cross_items) AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1829.93 + 1.61 AND d_moy = 10.16 GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id HAVING SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales) UNION ALL SELECT 'web' AS channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sales, COUNT(*) AS number_sales FROM web_sales, item, date_dim WHERE ws_item_sk IN (SELECT ss_item_sk FROM cross_items) AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1777.74 + 2.19 AND d_moy = 10.76 GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id HAVING SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)) AS y GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id) ORDER BY channel NULLS LAST, i_brand_id NULLS LAST, i_class_id NULLS LAST, i_category_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

b_city, ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip, ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name, ad2.ca_city AS c_city, ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip, d1.d_year AS syear, d2.d_year AS fsyear, d3.d_year AS s2year, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1, SUM(ss_list_price) AS s2, SUM(ss_coupon_amt) AS s3 FROM store_sales, store_returns, cs_ui, date_dim AS d1, date_dim AS d2, date_dim WITH ss_items AS (SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_item_rev FROM store_sales, item, date_dim WHERE ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date = '2000-01-03')) AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk GROUP BY i_item_id), cs_items AS (SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev FROM catalog_sales, item, date_dim WHERE cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date = '2000-01-03')) AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk GROUP BY i_item_id), ws_items AS (SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS ws_item_rev FROM web_sales, item, date_dim WHERE ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date = '2000-01-03')) AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk GROUP BY i_item_id) SELECT ss_items.item_id, ss_item_rev, ss_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ss_dev, cs_item_rev, cs_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS cs_dev, ws_item_rev, ws_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ws_dev, (ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3 AS average FROM ss_items, cs_items, ws_items WHERE ss_items.item_id = cs_items.item_id AND ss_items.item_id = ws_items.item_id AND ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs_item_rev AND ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev AND cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ss_item_rev AND 1.1 * ss_item_rev AND cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev AND ws_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ss_item_rev AND 1.1 * ss_item_rev AND ws_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs_item_rev ORDER BY ss_items.item_id, ss_item_rev LIMIT 100

WITH ssr AS (SELECT s_store_id AS store_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS returns_, SUM(ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0.0)) AS profit FROM store_sales LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns ON (ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number), date_dim, store, item, promotion WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-22' AS DATE) AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_current_price > 53.57 AND ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND p_channel_tv = 'N' GROUP BY s_store_id), csr AS (SELECT cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0.0)) AS returns_, SUM(cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0.0)) AS profit FROM catalog_sales LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number), date_dim, catalog_page, item, promotion WHERE cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-22' AS DATE) AND cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_current_price > 55.33 AND cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND p_channel_tv = 'N' GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id), wsr AS (SELECT web_site_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS returns_, SUM(ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0.0)) AS profit FROM web_sales LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns ON (ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number), date_dim, web_site, item, promotion WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-22' AS DATE) AND ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_current_price > 55.51 AND ws_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND p_channel_tv = 'N' GROUP BY web_site_id) SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns_) AS returns_, SUM(profit) AS profit FROM (SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, CONCAT('store', COALESCE(COALESCE(store_id, ''), '')) AS id, sales, returns_, profit FROM ssr UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, CONCAT('catalog_page', COALESCE(COALESCE(catalog_page_id, ''), '')) AS id, sales, returns_, profit FROM csr UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, CONCAT('web_site', COALESCE(COALESCE(web_site_id, ''), '')) AS id, sales, returns_, profit FROM wsr) AS x GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id) ORDER BY channel NULLS LAST, id NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

WITH results AS (SELECT SUM(ss_net_profit) AS ss_net_profit, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_ext_sales_price, (SUM(ss_net_profit) * 0.93) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price), 0) AS gross_margin, i_category, i_class, 0.0 AS g_category, 0.0 AS g_class FROM store_sales, date_dim AS d1, item, store WHERE d1.d_year = 2289.34 AND d1.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk AND s_state = 'TN' GROUP BY i_category, i_class), results_rollup AS (SELECT gross_margin, i_category, i_class, 0.0 AS t_category, 0.0 AS t_class, 0.0 AS lochierarchy FROM results UNION SELECT (SUM(ss_net_profit) * 0.98) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price), 0) AS gross_margin, i_category, NULL AS i_class, 0.0 AS t_category, 1.05 AS t_class, 1.07 AS lochierarchy FROM results GROUP BY i_category UNION SELECT (SUM(ss_net_profit) * 1.11) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price), 0) AS gross_margin, NULL AS i_category, NULL AS i_class, 1.11 AS t_category, 1.01 AS t_class, 2.4 AS lochierarchy FROM results) SELECT gross_margin, i_category, i_class, lochierarchy, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lochierarchy, CASE WHEN t_class = 0.0 THEN i_category END ORDER BY gross_margin ASC NULLS LAST) AS rank_within_parent FROM results_rollup ORDER BY lochierarchy DESC NULLS FIRST, CASE WHEN lochierarchy = 0.0 THEN i_category END NULLS LAST, rank_within_parent NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

WITH ss AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Music') AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2041.52 AND d_moy = 7.99 AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.99 GROUP BY i_item_id), cs AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales, customer_address WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Music') AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1876.06 AND d_moy = 8.54 AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.71 GROUP BY i_item_id), ws AS (SELECT i_item_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Music') AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1798.38 AND d_moy = 10.77 AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.64 GROUP BY i_item_id) SELECT i_item_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM ss UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws) AS tmp1 GROUP BY i_item_id ORDER BY i_item_id NULLS LAST, total_sales NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0.0)) AS profit FROM web_sales LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns ON (ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number), web_site, item WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-22' AS DATE) AND ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_current_price > 59.7 AND ws_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND p_channel_tv = 'N' GROUP BY web_site_id) SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns_) AS returns_, SUM(profit) AS profit FROM (SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, CONCAT('store', COALESCE(COALESCE(store_id, ''), '')) AS id, sales, returns_, profit FROM ssr UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, CONCAT('catalog_page', COALESCE(COALESCE(catalog_page_id, ''), '')) AS id, sales, returns_, profit FROM csr UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, CONCAT('web_site', COALESCE(COALESCE(web_site_id, ''), '')) AS id, sales, returns_, profit FROM wsr) AS x GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id) ORDER BY channel NULLS LAST, id NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT w_substr, sm_type, LOWER(cc_name) AS cc_name_lower, SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 30.63) THEN 1.19 ELSE 0.0 END) AS `30 days`, SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 24.65) AND (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 61.37) THEN 0.89 ELSE 0.0 END) AS `31-60 days`, SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 59.66) AND (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 92.15) THEN 0.95 ELSE 0.0 END) AS `61-90 days`, SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 78.76) AND (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 110.66) THEN 0.83 ELSE 0.0 END) AS `91-120 days`, SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 136.42) THEN 1.12 ELSE 0.0 END) AS `>120 days` FROM catalog_sales, (SELECT SUBSTRING(w_warehouse_name, 1, 20) AS w_substr, * FROM warehouse) AS sq1, ship_mode WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1433.49 AND 1041.21 + 8.92 AND cs_ship_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk AND cs_ship_mode_sk = sm_ship_mode_sk AND cs_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk GROUP BY w_substr, sm_type, cc_name ORDER BY w_substr NULLS LAST, sm_type NULLS LAST, cc_name_lower NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk, web_sales.ws_ship_hdemo_sk, web_page.wp_url, COUNT(*) FROM web_page LEFT ANTI JOIN web_sales ON web_page.wp_web_page_sk = web_sales.ws_web_page_sk LEFT ANTI JOIN catalog_sales ON catalog_sales.cs_warehouse_sk = web_sales.ws_warehouse_sk GROUP BY catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk, web_sales.ws_ship_hdemo_sk, web_page.wp_url LIMIT 259

WITH frequent_ss_items AS (SELECT itemdesc, i_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date AS solddate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_sales, date_dim, (SELECT SUBSTRING(i_item_desc, 1, 30) AS itemdesc, * FROM item) AS sq1 WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_year IN (1966.55, 2360.96 + 1.18, 1819.07 + 2.09, 2365.36 + 3.4) GROUP BY itemdesc, i_item_sk, d_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 3.93), max_store_sales AS (SELECT MAX(csales) AS tpcds_cmax FROM (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS csales FROM store_sales, customer, date_dim WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (1621.88, 2060.71 + 0.95, 2191.19 + 2.24, 2023.06 + 3.33) GROUP BY c_customer_sk) AS sq2), best_ss_customer AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS ssales FROM store_sales, customer, max_store_sales WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_customer_sk HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) > (57.4 / NULLIF(100.34, 0)) * MAX(tpcds_cmax)) SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, sales FROM (SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sales FROM catalog_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 2369.43 AND d_moy = 2.31 AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs_item_sk = item_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name UNION ALL SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sales FROM web_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 1632.66 AND d_moy = 2.32 AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws_item_sk = item_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name) AS sq3 ORDER BY c_last_name NULLS LAST, c_first_name NULLS LAST, sales NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT web_site.web_country, call_center.cc_employees, catalog_returns.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk, COUNT(*) FROM call_center LEFT JOIN web_site ON call_center.cc_open_date_sk = web_site.ws_open_date_sk INNER JOIN catalog_returns ON call_center.cc_call_center_sk = catalog_returns.cr_call_center_sk GROUP BY web_site.web_country, call_center.cc_employees, catalog_returns.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk LIMIT 475

WITH web_v1 AS (SELECT ws_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date, SUM(SUM(ws_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY ws_item_sk ORDER BY d_date NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS cume_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1053.64 AND 1242.9 + 11.8 AND NOT ws_item_sk IS NULL GROUP BY ws_item_sk, d_date), store_v1 AS (SELECT ss_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date, SUM(SUM(ss_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_item_sk ORDER BY d_date NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS cume_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1367.63 AND 1417.3 + 11.65 AND NOT ss_item_sk IS NULL GROUP BY ss_item_sk, d_date) SELECT * FROM (SELECT item_sk, d_date, web_sales, store_sales, MAX(web_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS web_cumulative, MAX(store_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS store_cumulative FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN NOT web.item_sk IS NULL THEN web.item_sk ELSE store.item_sk END AS item_sk, CASE WHEN NOT web.d_date IS NULL THEN web.d_date ELSE store.d_date END AS d_date, web.cume_sales AS web_sales, store.cume_sales AS store_sales FROM web_v1 AS web FULL OUTER JOIN store_v1 AS store ON (web.item_sk = store.item_sk AND web.d_date = store.d_date)) AS x) AS y WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative ORDER BY item_sk NULLS LAST, d_date NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

sr_store_sk AS store_sk, sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(7.55, 2.29)) AS sales_price, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(6.77, 2.01)) AS profit, sr_return_amt AS return_amt, sr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM store_returns) AS salesreturns, date_dim WHERE date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-06' AS DATE) AND store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, cs_net_profit AS profit, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(7.74, 1.67)) AS return_amt, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(5.79, 2.39)) AS net_loss FROM catalog_sales UNION ALL SELECT cr_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk, cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(6.86, 2.15)) AS sales_price, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(5.83, 2.06)) AS profit, cr_return_amount AS AND page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id), wsr AS (SELECT web_site_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns_, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM (SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk, ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, ws_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, ws_net_profit AS profit, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(7.57, 1.95)) AS return_amt, CAST(0.0 AS WITH ss AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics')) AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2332.68 AND d_moy = 4.62 AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.0 GROUP BY i_manufact_id), cs AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales, date_dim, item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics')) AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2205.92 AND d_moy = 5.88 AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -4.68 GROUP BY i_manufact_id), ws AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics')) AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2318.94 AND d_moy = 5.24 AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5.67 GROUP BY i_manufact_id) SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM ss UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws) AS tmp1 GROUP BY i_manufact_id ORDER BY total_sales NULLS LAST LIMIT 100
